summary: Make the terminal UI usage pane say when its objectives could not be read: never show a green all-clear while they load or fail, mark rows kept after a failed refresh as the last reading, and drop another member's rows on a member switch

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay change; the pane still reads slo.list and slo.history.

schema.detail: No table, index or migration change.

compatibility.detail: Client-only display change; no route, wire field or CLI output changes.

recovery.detail: Swapping back to an older build restores the earlier pane behaviour.
